prompt: Two sliders must always add up to 100, so moving one drags the other. Complete sync so it mirrors the value onto the other slider without the two change listeners calling each other forever.
explanation: setValue on a JSlider fires its ChangeListener straight away and on the same thread, so a listener that writes to the other slider triggers the other listener, which writes back -- an endless loop. A single boolean re-entry guard breaks the cycle: the first call claims the flag, and the nested call sees it set and returns immediately. Clearing the flag in a finally block guarantees the panel is not left permanently frozen if setValue ever throws.
hints: The very first line of sync should be: if (adjusting) return;
Set adjusting to true before touching the other slider and back to false afterwards -- a try/finally makes that safe.
Call refresh() only in the outer call, after the flag has been cleared; the nested call returns before it gets there.
